experiments.why: A product with no style code on file and no styleCode argument is now refused before any stock is written.
Registering a half size without style-number fields should still store the record under p100__5_5, but the new gate refuses it.
A qty 2 registration with no style-number fields should apply a received movement of 2, but the new gate stops it first.
A product whose style code is on file passes the new gate, so registration should still succeed with the code copied into the record.
A deliberate skip reason satisfies the new gate, and the saved record gains the skip reason and null style fields.

obligations.authorized_by: Registration refuses to complete without the style-number fact
obligations.statement: registerDisplayUnit({ hub: 'hub2', product, size: '6' }) with no style-number fields returns ok: true and adds one unit to that product's size-6 cell at the hub.
obligations.why: the pull request says it changes this

source.quote: registering the same display twice adds ONE unit, not two

obligations.statement: A second registerDisplayUnit call for the same (hub, product, size) returns ok: true and already: true, and the size cell stays at one unit with only one movement applied.

source.quote: even with the progress record lost, the movement id blocks a double add

obligations.statement: If the registration record for a slot is deleted after registering, registering the same (hub, product, size) again returns ok: true but the size cell still holds one unit.

source.quote: adds onto the hub's EXISTING quantity — a size 6 display adds 1 to size 6

obligations.statement: Registering size 6 when the hub's size-6 cell already holds qty 4 at version 7 leaves that cell at qty 5 and version 8.

source.quote: refuses every hub outside hub1/hub2 — Pine can never be touched

obligations.statement: registerDisplayUnit returns ok: false for any hub other than hub1 and hub2, such as hub3, marathon-pine, marathon-pe, trophy and central.

source.quote: refuses a size that would encode to the one-size sentinel — the Free Size leak

obligations.statement: registerDisplayUnit returns ok: false for the sizes '', '_', 'Free Size' and null, and writes no stock at all.

source.quote: stock changes go through applyMovement — the register write path builds a received movement to the hub

obligations.statement: registerDisplayUnit with qty 2 passes applyMovement a movement of type 'received' to the hub with qty 2.

source.quote: keeps a per-slot record the count pass and Leftovers read

obligations.statement: After registering size '5.5', loadRegister(hub) holds a record under the key '<productId>__5_5' whose size is the raw string '5.5'.

source.quote: a style code resolves through styleCodeNormalised, size unknown

obligations.statement: A scan of style code 'CT8527-016', when only product p1 has styleCodeNormalised 'CT8527016', makes resolveCleanupScan return kind 'product' with product p1 and size null.

source.quote: a code two live products claim is a DUPLICATE, never a guess

obligations.statement: When two live products (p1 and p9) both have styleCodeNormalised 'CT8527016', a scan of 'CT8527-016' makes resolveCleanupScan return kind 'duplicate' listing exactly those two products instead of picking one.

source.quote: an unknown code is UNRESOLVED — a calm signal, not an error

obligations.statement: For a code that no product or barcode row owns, such as '6009999999', resolveCleanupScan returns kind 'unresolved' with code equal to that raw code, without throwing.

source.quote: a merged-away product never resolves as itself from a style code

obligations.statement: A style code owned only by a product that has been merged into another (mergedInto set) makes resolveCleanupScan return kind 'unresolved', never the merged-away product.

openDuplicateFor returns the open duplicate row involving the product with otherId set to the other product ('a' for 'b'), and null when the product's only row has status 'merged' or no row involves it.

source.quote: stock-holding footwear minus the registered set, biggest first

obligations.statement: buildLeftovers returns the hub's stock-holding footwear products that have no registration record, largest stock first, leaving out registered products and non-footwear such as clothing.

source.quote: a merged-away product is nobody's leftover

obligations.statement: buildLeftovers never lists a product that has been merged into another, even when that product still holds stock at the hub and is unregistered.

source.quote: Every location this product holds stock at (non-zero), with qty and per-size detail.

obligations.statement: locationsHolding returns one entry per location where the product's stock is non-zero, negative included, each with its total qty and per-size quantities, and leaves out locations holding none of it.

source.quote: counts stock-holding footwear seen against expected

obligations.statement: For footwear products p1, p2 and p3 where the hub holds stock of p1 and p2 and only p1 size 6 is registered with qty 1, registrationProgress returns seen 1, expected 2 and units 1.

source.quote: the one-size sentinel is never a pickable display size

obligations.statement: realSizes drops the '_' one-size sentinel and blank sizes (sizes ['6', '_', ' ', '7'] give ['6', '7']) and returns [] for a product with no sizes.
